_doc: Player profiles of the pacing optimizer (Step 50). bot: the play bot's way of playing (tools/playtest/autoplayer.gd profile). step_ms: time between decisions; first_ms: the first decision (the first look); explore_every: every Nth decision goes on looking around; tutorial_taps: stages done by hand before the tutorial turns to the Momo; minutes: default length. 'blind' is calibrated on the Step 45 blind AI playtests of v0.49.0 (taps 9-11 s apart, first tap 8-11 s) -- see design/INCREMENTAL_PACING.md.
